name: deathversary
source:
Today is Elliot's death anniversary, or deathversery, as Luke calls it. Help Luke spend the day with his ghost boyfriend.

deathversary is a free small renpy visual novel done for surreal game jam.

[From [url=https://recarmdran.itch.io/deathversary] itch.io[/url]]
